description.zh:
分配类型。取值范围：

- Normal：查询当前账号下的预留实例券。
- Shared：查询当前账号下已经建立主子账号共享的预留实例券。

默认值：Normal。
description.en:
The allocation type of the reserved instances. Valid values:

- Normal: queries all reserved instances that belong to the current account.

- Shared: queries the reserved instances that are shared between the current main account and linked accounts.

Default value: Normal.

description.zh:
预留实例券对应的实例规格。取值请参见[实例规格族](~~25378~~)。 

> 购买预留实例券时选择的实例规格，实际抵扣的时候，地域级预留实例券支持同规格组内的不同大小规格换算抵扣。
description.en:
The instance type of the reserved instance. For information about the valid values, see [Overview of instance families](~~25378~~).

> Specify the instance type that you selected when you purchased the reserved instance. If the reserved instance is a regional reserved instance, it can be used to offset the bills of instance types that belong to the same instance family as the specified instance type, regardless of instance specifications.

description.zh: 预留实例券对应的实例规格族。取值请参见[实例规格族](~~25378~~)。
description.en: The instance family of the reserved instance. For information about the valid values, see [Overview of instance families](~~25378~~).

description.zh:
锁定类型。取值范围：

- financial：账号欠费或服务过期。
- security：安全原因。
description.en:
The reason why the reserved instance is locked. Valid values:

- financial: The reserved instance is locked because the account has overdue payments or the service expires.

- security: The reserved instance is locked due to security reasons.

description.zh:
预留实例券的付款类型。取值范围：

- No Upfront：零预付。
- Partial Upfront：部分预付。
- All Upfront：全预付。
description.en:
The payment option of the reserved instance. Valid values:

- No Upfront

- Partial Upfront

- All Upfront

description.zh:
预留实例券列表的页码，起始值：1。

默认值：1。
description.en:
The page number. Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页查询时的每页行数，最大值：100。

默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10.

description.zh: 预留实例券所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)获取最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the reserved instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 预留实例券ID数组。数组长度：1~100。
description.en: The IDs of reserved instances. You can specify up to 100 IDs of reserved instances.

description.zh:
预留实例券名称。

> 完全匹配，暂不支持模糊查询过滤。
description.en:
The name of the reserved instance.

> Only exact search is supported.

description.zh:
预留实例券的范围。取值范围：
         
- Region：地域级别。
- Zone：可用区级别。
description.en:
The scope level of the reserved instance. Valid values:

- Region: regional

- Zone: zonal

description.zh: 预留实例券的状态数组。
description.en: The status of the reserved instances.
The tags of the reserved instance. You can specify up to 20 tags.

description.zh:
预留实例券的标签键。不允许为空字符串，最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。

> 使用一个标签过滤资源，查询到该标签下的资源数量不能超过1000个；使用多个标签过滤资源，查询到同时绑定了多个标签的资源数量不能超过1000个；如果资源数量超过1000个，请使用[ListTagResources](~~110425~~)接口进行查询。
description.en:
The key of tag N of the reserved instance. The tag key cannot be empty and can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with aliyun or acs: and cannot contain http\:// or https\://.

> If you specify a single tag to query resources, up to 1,000 resources to which the tag is added are returned. If you specify multiple tags to query resources, up to 1,000 resources to which all specified tags are added are returned. To query more than 1,000 resources that have specified tags added, call the [ListTagResources](~~110425~~) operation.

description.zh: 预留实例券的标签值。不允许为空字符串,最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The value of tag N of the reserved instance. The tag value cannot be empty and can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 实例所属的可用区编号，当Scope为Zone时生效并且必填。您可以通过[DescribeZones](~~25610~~)获取可用区列表。
description.en: The zone ID of the reserved instance. This parameter is valid and required if you set Scope to Zone. You can call the [DescribeZones](~~25610~~) operation to query the most recent zone list.

title.zh: 查询预留实例券详细信息列表

descriptions.zh:
### 适用场景
- 查询指定地域下所有的预留实例券。
- 根据预留实例券ID或名称查询其详细信息。
- 根据实例规格或者实例规格族过滤查询您已购买的预留实例券。
- 根据预留实例券范围或者状态过滤查询您已购买的预留实例券。

### 请求示例
<details>
<summary>示例：查询杭州地域下所有已购买的预留实例券</summary>

```
"Region":"cn-hangzhou" //设置地域为杭州
```
</details>
<details>
<summary>示例：查询杭州地域下ID为ecsri-bp129enntoynwwj5****的预留实例券的详细信息</summary>

```
"Region":"cn-hangzhou", //设置地域为杭州
"ReservedInstanceId":"ecsri-bp129enntoynwwj5****" //设置预留实例券ID
```
</details>
<details>
<summary>示例：查询杭州地域下可以抵扣实例规格为ecs.c5.2xlarge的预留实例券</summary>

```
"Region":"cn-hangzhou", //设置地域为杭州
"InstanceType":"ecs.c5.2xlarge" //设置实例规格
```
</details>
<details>
<summary>示例：查询杭州地域下在有效期中的地域级预留实例券</summary>

```
"Region":"cn-hangzhou", //设置地域为杭州
"Scope":"Region", //设置预留实例券范围
"Status":["Active"] //设置状态为在有效期中
```
</details>
descriptions.en:
### [](#)Scenarios

- Query all reserved instances in a specific region.

- Query the details of a reserved instance based on the ID or name.

- Query your purchased reserved instances based on the instance type or instance family.

- Query your purchased reserved instances based on the scope or status of reserved instances.

### [](#)Sample requests

**Example: Query all purchased reserved instances in the China (Hangzhou) region**

```
"RegionId":"cn-hangzhou", //The ID of the region.
```

**Example: Query the details of the reserved instance whose ID is ecsri-bp129enntoynwwj5\*\*\*\* in the China (Hangzhou) region**

```
"RegionId":"cn-hangzhou", //The ID of the region."ReservedInstanceId":"ecsri-bp129enntoynwwj5****" //The ID of the reserved instance.
```

**Example: Query the reserved instances that can be used to offset the bills of ecs.c5.2xlarge instances in the China (Hangzhou) region**

```
"RegionId":"cn-hangzhou", //The ID of the region."InstanceType":"ecs.c5.2xlarge", //The instance type.
```

**Example: Query the regional reserved instances that are within the validity period in the China (Hangzhou) region**

```
"RegionId":"cn-hangzhou", //The ID of the region."Scope":"Region", //Set the scope of the reserved instance to regional."Status":["Active"] //Set the status to Active, which indicates that the reserved instance is within the validity period.
```

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs describe-reserved-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --zone-id cn-hangzhou-z --reserved-instance-name testReservedInstanceName --lock-reason security --instance-type ecs.g5.large --instance-type-family ecs.g5 --scope Region --offering-type All_Upfront --allocation-type Normal --reserved-instance-id ri-bpzhex2ulpzf530000 --status Active --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs DescribeReservedInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Status.1 Active --Tag.1.Key TestKey --PageSize 50 --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-z' --InstanceTypeFamily 'ecs.g5' --AllocationType Normal --ReservedInstanceId.1 'ri-bpzhex2ulpzf530000' --OfferingType All_Upfront --Scope Region --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value TestValue --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ReservedInstanceName testReservedInstanceName --LockReason security --InstanceType 'ecs.g5.large'
